title: (Theme 7: Kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child underlines the main point of each paragraph, crosses out examples, and writes the points in his own words within the limit.

floor.prerequisite: Finds the main idea of a paragraph.
floor.question: Wazo kuu la aya hii ni lipi?

steps: Underline the main point of each paragraph.
Write in your words and count.

board.do: Shule zinapaswa kujenga njia za kupitisha viti vya magurudumu.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes a 60-word summary of the passage.

misconceptions.ask: Sentensi hii ni yako au ya mwandishi?

listen_for: Kwa mfano, shule ya Kilimani ilijenga njia mbili mwaka 2025.
misconceptions.ask: Hili ni hoja kuu au ni mfano?
misconceptions.repair: Ufupisho hubeba hoja kuu tu, si mifano.

listen_for: Shule zinapaswa kujenga njia za kupitisha viti vya magurudumu.

checks.question: Ni lipi liingie katika ufupisho: hoja kuu au mfano?
